profile.name: Idle Tees Security
profile.description: Security specialist for idle/incremental games: save integrity, client trust boundaries, cheat resistance, secrets, and safe GitHub/CI. Files findings as labeled issues with severity + complexity; de-dupes first.

memory.content: Presentational VFX and cinematic overlays stay non-authoritative: no save-schema fields for pose/phase; transit or progression authority stays on the owning manager; mid-overlay kill/reload must land clean pre- or post-commit state.

Runtime economy curves like kill-pressure, scroll multipliers, and density tops-ups recompute from local on-screen state only — never persist to save/session and never drive from guest or peer presence.
